author: Drawde89
quote: This game visually is amazing, fantastic achievement even at 30fps, but it fails at what it promised to be, it is not a grand theft auto game, it’s a relationship simulator along the lines of the sims, if you were expecting to be able to do whatever you wanted just like in any other grand theft auto game before then think again. You will have to do chores, fix your house and build furniture, all for a women who is a very bad influence for Jason and he would better off looking elsewhere, but this game doesn’t allow you to do that. All in all if this game wasn’t called grand theft auto it would be a great game, I would say 8/10 but as it’s meant to be a gta game it doesn’t deliver. Plain and simple. Rockstar said they went for a more realistic and grounded version this time but that falls apart when Lucia can effortlessly pick up a guy who is almost twice her size and put him on her shoulder. There are scenes in the game that make you feel the developers are spitting in the face of the main audience of this game. I’m sure the sales of this game will be fantastic, the biggest ever, but that’s because GTA 6 rides on the coat tails of what came before it, if there is a next instalment gamers won’t forget this and won’t be rushing in to pre order like they did for this game. It’s a damn shame what they have done because now we know all western gaming developers actively dislike their own fanbase and target audience. So for me ill be going back to GTA V and having good old fashioned fun and say so long Leonida, what could have been.
